plainTranslation: Your emotional natures mirror each other. You react the same way, need the same comfort, and feel instantly at home together. Failure mode: shared blind spots - if you both avoid conflict or both spiral, no one holds the other steady. Treasure the resonance and watch the patterns you'll both reinforce.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
You may feel comfortable with this person faster than you expected. Being around them can feel strangely familiar, as if they already understand parts of you that most people take longer to notice. There is often a sense that you do not have to work so hard to explain how you are feeling because they naturally seem to meet you where you are.

When this works, it can feel deeply reassuring. This person may have a way of responding that makes you feel understood rather than managed. You may notice yourself relaxing around them because there is less pressure to hide what you are feeling. Even on days when you are struggling, overwhelmed, or not quite yourself, you can feel accepted as you are. There is a quiet relief in not having to pretend everything is fine just to stay connected.

There can be a feeling of being emotionally understood without having to work for it. The things that make you feel cared for may be similar, so it becomes easier to look after each other in the ways that actually land. You may find yourselves creating a shared sense of comfort almost automatically.

The growth here is learning that understanding each other is not the same thing as helping each other grow. Because your emotional instincts are so similar, you may reinforce each other's habits without questioning them. At times that is healing. At other times it can keep both of you stuck in the same mood, the same fear, or the same way of coping. This is one of the harder bonds to walk away from, because it can keep two people together long after the rest of the relationship has stopped working, simply because the comfort feels like home. The challenge is knowing when to offer comfort and when to gently help each other move forward.

This connection works best when safety becomes a place to recover, not a place to hide. Sometimes love is settling in together. Sometimes love is helping each other come back up.
